slices.summary: Colleen closes the 2027-2028 school-year tracker: 70+ booked class visits or outreach programs, 18+ district or charter schools, three program packages being rebooked by teachers, and multiple volunteer-led visits running cleanly without her intervention. The evidence matches what the work has felt like day-to-day. She feels deeply relieved rather than hyped, recognizing the program is now dependable rather than fragile. She plans a one-page summary leading with 'dependable year-round program' backed by specific metrics, ending with what to protect next year (repeat-ready packages, volunteer consistency, school follow-through).
